title: Probing Physics in Motion Diffusion Models Against Their Own Estimate
abstract: arXiv:2611.24423v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies report that video diffusion models "know more than they show": physical properties decode better from their activations than from their inputs or outputs. But a diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from those same activations, so such a comparison measures how easily a readout extracts the information. Whether the model hides anything is a separate question. We set out to find hidden physical knowledge in kinematic text-to-motion diffusion models, where the physics of every intermediate estimate can be computed exactly, and recorded every layer along the sampling trajectories of MDM (two checkpoints) and MotionDiffuse. Against the usual baselines the layers do look ahead of the model's own estimate on balance and flight. translated_title: 以自身估计为基准探测运动扩散模型中的物理知识
translated_abstract: 最近的研究报告称，视频扩散模型“知道的比它们表现出来的更多”：物理属性从其内部激活值中解码的效果优于从其输入或输出中解码。然而，扩散模型正是从这些相同的激活值计算出其干净样本估计值的，因此这类比较实际衡量的只是读取方法提取信息的难易程度，而模型是否隐藏了信息则是另一个独立的问题。我们着手在运动学文本到动作扩散模型中寻找隐藏的物理知识——在这类模型中，每个中间估计值的物理属性都可以被精确计算——并记录了MDM（两个检查点）和MotionDiffuse采样轨迹上的每一层。与通常的基线相比，这些内部层在平衡和飞行方面确实看起来领先于模型自身的估计。但当所有读取方法以相同方式调整后，模型自身的估计缩小了这一差距：对于平衡和飞行，额外读取一层最多只带来0.01的增益，而阳性对照实验表明我们能够检测到这一量级的差异。
tldr: 该研究对运动扩散模型的内部激活进行逐层物理探测后发现，当读取方法被公平调整时，模型自身的干净样本估计与内部激活的表现相当（差距最多仅0.01），表明此前报告的“隐藏物理知识”更多是读取方法可提取性差异造成的假象，而非模型真正隐藏了物理信息。
en_tdlr: When readout probes are tuned equally, the model's own clean-sample estimate matches what can be decoded from internal layer activations in motion diffusion models (gains of at most 0.01 for balance and flight), showing that purported "hidden" physical knowledge reflects readout extractability rather than information the model actually conceals.
